subject: dsa
title: Best Time to Buy and Sell Stock with Cooldown
summary: Track three states per day. holding[d] keeps or buys today, sold[d] sells what was held, and can-buy[d] waits through the cooldown after a sale. The answer is the best of can-buy and sold on the last day.
problem: Maximize profit trading prices = [1, 2, 3, 0, 2] with a one-day cooldown after each sell. Rows are the three states (can-buy, holding, sold-today); columns are days 0 through 4. holding[d] = max(holding[d-1], canbuy[d-1] - price[d]); sold[d] = holding[d-1] + price[d]; canbuy[d] = max(canbuy[d-1], sold[d-1]).

steps.caption: Rows are can-buy, holding, and sold-today. Columns are the days for prices [1, 2, 3, 0, 2]. The answer is the best of can-buy and sold on the last day.
Day 0 at price 1. We can-buy with profit 0, holding means we bought so profit is -1, and nothing is sold yet so 0.
Fill days 1 and 2. Selling at the rising prices lifts sold to 1 then 2, while can-buy follows the prior sold value.
Fill days 3 and 4. Buying at price 0 then selling at price 2 pushes sold up to 3, and can-buy settles at 2.
The best of can-buy 2 and sold 3 on the last day is 3, so the maximum profit is 3.
